=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Fix the remaining comment-handling issues: accept failure markers only on the final standalone line, and prevent untrusted comments from changing failure counts or retry limits." (PR description)
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:773, count_autofix_failure_streak textual-marker match (`if any(marker in body for marker in AUTOFIX_FAILURE_COMMENT_MARKERS)`)
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds author filtering to count_autofix_failure_streak (lines 764, 770-771) and passes it from the reporter, which closes the untrusted-comment half. The other half — anchoring the textual-marker match — is not implemented. Line 773 still uses substring matching anywhere in the body, while the sibling linked-comments check at line 2423 already anchors the same textual markers with `body.strip().startswith(AUTOFIX_FAILURE_COMMENT_MARKERS)`. The structured `<!-- review-autofix-failure:v1 ... -->` marker is anchored in count_identical_failures via _FAILURE_MARKER_TRAILING_RE, but count_autofix_failure_streak still has no anchor for the textual markers it scans. The author filter mitigates the untrusted-author attack, but a trusted commenter (a stale pipeline comment that happens to contain the phrase in its body) would still falsely count as a failure.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
